items.title: Where Start Workout Goes
items.why:
On a 393 x 852 screen the button is mostly behind the tab bar. Workout B is shown, as it's the taller one.

Every choice except Keep brings the whole button into view for both workouts in both looks, and adds a small gap under the A and B buttons. I also measured a small 375 x 667 phone: Start Workout shows there too in the first two, but not in the one-line or folded lists.

I tried removing only the "Erica's Workout" line. That wasn't enough for Workout B.
